title: Increasing Quantum of Rebates under Electric Vehicle Early Adoption Incentive Scheme and Extending the Scheme
what_it_is: Increasing Quantum of Rebates under Electric Vehicle Early Adoption Incentive Scheme and Extending the Scheme

sections.label: Electric Vehicle Early Adoption Incentive
sections.summary: The EEAI scheme, introduced in 2021, narrows the upfront cost gap between electric and ICE cars, and will be reviewed later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister of Transport)
sentences.text: The Electric Vehicle Early Adoption Incentive (EEAI) scheme was introduced in 2021 to encourage adoption of electric cars by narrowing the upfront cost gap between electric and internal combustion engine (ICE) cars.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister of Transport)
sentences.text: Adoption of electric cars has been increasing – last year, around one third of new car registrations were electric cars.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister of Transport)
sentences.text: We will review the EEAI later this year, taking into consideration factors such as EV adoption rates and upfront cost difference across powertrains.
